approval.decision: Kris explicitly approved the current A2 focused editor (focused-refined / focused-v2): "approved". This followed the refined preview and clarification that viewport Height, and then surrounding Window Height if needed, can increase the visible area. This selects the L04 design extension; flow-v1, C5 composition and paired-v2 numeric approvals retain their scope.
behaviour: Keep the approved Choose / Design / Connect editor with a persistent canvas and one focused editing panel. Hierarchy, source statements, canvas clicks and ancestor links select the same element.

Restore the approved paired horizontal/vertical position and anchor controls, pixel/relative units, alignment presets, dimensions, expandable size limits and window/frame padding. Keep Apply/Cancel visible outside desktop form scrolling and sticky at compact width.

Show grid columns, rows, spacing, direct-child count and capacity together. Use literal axes 1 through 64 as an authoring bound pending SDK qualification, fill rows in source order, and generate allow_underfull True. Refuse a capacity smaller than the current child count and retain/focus the draft.
Use window/frame/viewport single-child rules and horizontal/vertical/grid parent constraints. Explain controlled placement and link directly to the parent while retaining child drafts.

Viewport width and height control the visible opening at the initial top-left. Increasing viewport Height reveals more content; surrounding Window Height can also be increased when its own bounds constrain the result. Wheel, drag, keys, scrollbars, bindings, offsets and child-size expressions remain Source-only for L04.

Add with an explicit type and parent, a pending schematic label, contextual child-group destinations and retained input on refusal. New grids, windows and viewports can start empty. Text entry appears only for text and textbutton.

Keep the nested keyboard hierarchy, type icons, draft markers, Enter/double-click Design entry, pointer sibling ordering, Alt+Up/Down and explicit Move earlier/later controls. Move groups with descendants and refuse moves across custom Source.

Every eligible removal opens the confirmed C5-style modal with the element or descendant list and initial Cancel focus. Cancel/Escape retain layout, focus, scroll, source and history. Confirm creates one history entry, selects the next sibling, else previous sibling, else parent, and Undo restores the subtree and selected target.

Apply current element fields together as one history entry; no-op Apply creates none. Enter applies numeric edits; Escape cancels. Invalid values, source conflicts, selection, parent links, preview focus and resolution changes retain drafts. Keep per-element disclosure state, form scroll and numeric focus through Apply.

Source opens separately without resizing the canvas and shows accepted sample source only. Statement selection returns to the element. Connect shows the existing Close Hide-help action without executing it; Test in Ren'Py remains a deliberate real-project operation in production.
Keep Fit/75%/100% editor zoom, focus preview and compact Show canvas/Back to editing navigation. Canvas selection never runs game actions.

This approval extends the earlier approved editor and does not remove existing pointer move/resize, style/asset pickers, shared-look editing or the broader action builder. Their previous approved references remain authoritative.
deviations: This prototype uses fictional browser-memory state and generated sample Source. Its HTML canvas is schematic; it does not prove Ren'Py fidelity, minimal source patches, durable save/reopen, native input or SDK behavior.

This refinement simulates layout and composition controls relevant to L04. Pointer move/resize gestures, style/asset pickers, shared-look editing and the broader action builder are not reimplemented in this mock and retain their existing approved behavior in production.

The chosen grid authoring range and stationary viewport subset still require production and pinned-SDK qualification. Unsupported expressions/ranges remain lossless Source-only regions. No scrolling capability is selected by this approval.

The full Design Lab gate has retained startup and existing approved-reference failures. Focused browser checks pass within their recorded scope; these failures are not treated as passes or as waived acceptance. No shared runner or existing approval record is changed.
